name: Goreme Town Center
description: The walkable core where most nomads base themselves, packed with cave hotels, cafes, tour offices, and shops around the bus station. Everything is minutes away on foot, valley trailheads start at the edges, and sunrise balloons fill the sky right overhead each clear morning.
bestFor: First-time visitors and short-stay nomads wanting everything walkable
pros: Best choice of cafes and cave hotels
Balloon views straight from your terrace
cons: Can feel crowded in high season

name: Uchisar
tagline: The castle-rock village on the hill
description: A quieter hilltop village crowned by Uchisar Castle, the highest point in Cappadocia, with sweeping panoramic views over the valleys. A short dolmus ride from Goreme, it offers boutique cave stays and a calmer, more residential feel while staying close to the action.
bestFor: Long-stayers wanting quiet, views, and a slower pace
pros: Calmer and less crowded than Goreme
cons: Need transport for errands and nightlife

name: Urgup
tagline: The larger town with wine and services
description: A bigger, more full-service town about a 20-minute drive from Goreme, with real shops, banks, markets, restaurants, and a notable wine scene from surrounding vineyards. It offers a more everyday, year-round urban base while keeping the region's fairy-chimney character and easy access to the valleys.
bestFor: Long-term stays needing amenities and a lived-in town feel
pros: More shops, services, and everyday amenities
Strong local wine and dining scene
cons: Transport needed to reach Goreme sights

name: Avanos
tagline: The pottery town on the red river
description: A riverside town on the Kizilirmak, Turkey's longest river, famous for centuries-old pottery and ceramic workshops using the local red clay. Roughly 20 minutes from Goreme, it has a relaxed, authentic small-town feel, riverfront cafes, and craft traditions that make it a rewarding, less touristy base.
bestFor: Craft lovers and those wanting an authentic local base
cons: Away from the main balloon valleys
